units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:2">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>טוֹרֵף ואוכל</he> tears in order to satisfy his appetite.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:11">Koh. R. to X, 11</cite> <he>הארי ט׳</he> the lion goes out for prey.
<cite ref="Sotah 47b:21">Sot. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>טוֹרְפֵי טֶרֶף</he> those robbing (the poor).
<cite ref="Zevachim 53b:8">Zeb. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>חלקו של טוֹרֵף</he> the territory of the tearer (wolf = Benjamin, <cite ref="Genesis 49:27">Gen. XLIX, 27</cite>).

senses.gloss: to cast with force, knock, strike against; to throw away, reject, eject.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:3">Ḥull. III, 3</cite> <he>טְרָפָהּ בכותל</he> he cast or knocked the bird against the wall.

<cite ref="Berakhot 5b:25">Ber. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>טוֹרְפִין לו וכ׳</he> his prayer is thrown in his face (refused).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:4:2">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top <he>טְרָפַנִי</he>, v. <cite ref="I00712"><he>טָרַד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 15a:21">B. Mets. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>ובא ב״ח וטְרָפָהּ</he> and a creditor of the previous owner came and seized it, v. <cite ref="I00453"><he>טִירְפָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 19:2">Sabb. XIX, 2</cite> <he>ט׳ יין ושמן</he> beat wine and oil; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="I00731"><he>טָרוּף</he></cite>, f. <he>טְרוּפָה</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 38a">Ib. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>בשר ט׳</he> chopped meat.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:6">Ab. Zar. II, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00826"><he>טָרִית</he></cite>. Y. Nidd. IV, 51ᵃ (of a foetus).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 80b">80ᵇ</cite>) <he>ביצה ט׳</he> an egg beaten and mixed with oil; a. fr. V. <cite ref="I00731"><he>טָרוּף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:1">Kil. IX, 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 3:2:3">Y. Orl. III, 63ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 6:7:4">Y. Keth. VI, end, 31ᵃ</cite> <he>צמר בכור שטְרָפוֹ</he> wool of a first-born that has been hackled (and mixed up with, other wool).
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 2:4">Makhsh. II, 4</cite> <he>הטוֹרֵף את גגו</he> (Var. <he>המטהר</he>) if one scrubs his roof; <cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 1:8">Tosef. ib. I, 8</cite>.

senses.gloss: to make טְרֵפָה, to inflict an organic defect.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 85b">Ḥull. 85ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>צא טְרוֹף</he> go and maim the animal (before slaughtering it).
